_meta.purpose: Raw inputs and official "Individuella resultat" rows for testing getIndividualPerformance end to end. Generated by `pnpm perf:fixture --individual-results`; do not edit by hand.
_meta.ratings: dated: "<id>@<YYYY-MM-01>" from /player/{id}/date at the round month; table: <id> from the individual results table (fallback for players the dated lookup lacks)
_meta.notInApi: official rows whose player appears in no API game (e.g. Torsdagskampen HT26 "Grupp 2", absent from the API tournament)
_meta.noGames: official rows with SP 0: players registered to a team who never played (not derivable from round results)
